children: Colombia’s leading economic index rose 1.11% year over year in July 2026, slowing from a 3.51% increase in the previous month.
The increase was driven by a 2.59% rise in the tertiary activities index.
Meanwhile, the primary activities index declined 3.72%, while the secondary activities index decreased 2.3%.
On a monthly basis, the leading economic index rose 0.97%.
Year to date, the index increased 2.60%.

title: Colombia Economic Index Gains in July
